cat << 'EOF' > test_calc.py
import sqlite3

def run():
    conn = sqlite3.connect('data.sqlite')
    c = conn.cursor()
    
    rev_gap_sql = """
    SELECT 
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Revenue' AND basis='GAAP') 
        - 
        (SELECT midpoint * (1 + range_width / 100.0) FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period='Q3FY2025' AND measure='Revenue' AND basis='GAAP')
    """
    
    adj_gp_sql = """
    SELECT 
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit' AND basis='GAAP')
        + 
        (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit')
    """
    
    adj_gm_sql = """
    SELECT 
        ((SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit' AND basis='GAAP')
        + 
        (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit'))
        * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Revenue' AND basis='GAAP')
    """
    
    margin_gap_sql = """
    SELECT 
        (((SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit' AND basis='GAAP')
        + 
        (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM adjustments WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Gross profit'))
        * 100.0 / 
        (SELECT amount FROM financials WHERE period_end='2024-10-27' AND months=3 AND measure='Revenue' AND basis='GAAP')
        - 
        (SELECT midpoint + range_width / 100.0 FROM guidance WHERE fiscal_period='Q3FY2025' AND measure='Gross margin' AND basis='non-GAAP')
        ) * 100.0
    """
    
    print("rev_gap:", c.execute(rev_gap_sql).fetchone()[0])
    print("adj_gp:", c.execute(adj_gp_sql).fetchone()[0])
    print("adj_gm:", c.execute(adj_gm_sql).fetchone()[0])
    print("margin_gap:", c.execute(margin_gap_sql).fetchone()[0])

run()
EOF
